summary.text: Michelle Craig is an independent write-in candidate for the 33rd District. In her Ballotpedia survey she describes herself as a Texas native running as an independent, and little other biographical information is public.

paragraphs.text: Michelle Craig describes herself in a Ballotpedia survey as born in Texas and having lived most of her life in the state.
She is running as a declared independent write-in candidate in the November 3, 2026 general election; Ballotpedia lists no prior offices or professional history for her.
